name: chatbot-sst
description: Pipeline de ingesta y normalizacion documental para chatbot SST.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:venv && npm run setup:deps && npm run secrets:init
scripts.setup:venv: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const run = (cmd, args) => { const result = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status || 1); }; const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const candidates = []; if (process.env.PYTHON) candidates.push(process.env.PYTHON); if (isWin) candidates.push('py'); candidates.push('python3.12', 'python3.11', 'python3.10', 'python3', 'python'); const resolvePython = () => { for (const candidate of candidates) { const args = isWin && candidate === 'py' ? ['-3'] : []; const result = spawnSync(candidate, [...args, '--version'], { stdio: 'ignore' }); if (result.status === 0) return { cmd: candidate, args }; } console.error('No compatible Python interpreter found. Install Python 3.12.x and try again.'); process.exit(1); }; const python = resolvePython(); if (fs.existsSync('.venv')) { fs.rmSync('.venv', { recursive: true, force: true }); } run(python.cmd, [...python.args, '-m', 'venv', '.venv']);"
scripts.setup:deps: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const path = require('path'); const run = (cmd, args) => { const result = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status || 1); }; const venvPython = process.platform === 'win32' ? path.join('.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe') : path.join('.venv', 'bin', 'python'); run(venvPython, ['-m', 'pip', 'install', '--upgrade', 'pip', 'setuptools', 'wheel']); run(venvPython, ['-m', 'pip', 'install', '-e', '.[dev]']);"
scripts.setup:python: npm run setup:venv && npm run setup:deps
scripts.test:pipeline: npm run python -- -m pytest app/back/tests/embedding app/back/tests/indexing app/back/tests/retrieval
scripts.gui:dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const api = spawn('npm', ['run', 'gui:api'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const front = spawn('npm', ['run', 'gui:front'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const stop = () => { api.kill('SIGTERM'); front.kill('SIGTERM'); }; process.on('SIGINT', stop); process.on('SIGTERM', stop);"
scripts.python: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const path = require('path'); const candidates = process.platform === 'win32' ? ['C:\\venvs\\chatbot-sst\\Scripts\\python.exe', path.join('.venv', 'Scripts', 'python.exe')] : [path.join('.venv', 'bin', 'python')]; const venvPython = candidates.find((candidate) => require('fs').existsSync(candidate)) || candidates[candidates.length - 1]; const args = process.argv.slice(1); const result = spawnSync(venvPython, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status || 1);" --
